articles.title: IMD weather today: ‘Red’ alert for heavy rains in Odisha, Kerala, Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for extremely heavy rainfall across several districts in Odisha and Kerala, while torrential downpours continue to disrupt normal life in Tamil Nadu. With severe waterlogging, localised flooding, and emergency rescues already underway in the southern states, authorities are bracing for further impact over the coming days.
articles.title_hi: IMD का मौसम आज: ओडिशा, केरल, तमिलनाडु में भारी बारिश का 'रेड' अलर्ट

articles.title: Indian cartoonists face Instagram blocks amid growing political satire curbs
articles.summary: Indian cartoonists Satish Acharya and Manjul recently found their Instagram accounts and posts restricted in India without clear explanations from Meta platforms. Free speech advocates warn that legal content removal orders under information technology rules are stifling political satire and freedom of expression. Artists maintain that challenging those in power remains a vital part of their democratic role.

articles.title: Rajasthan feels first night chill: Minimum temperature drops to 13°C in Fatehpur and Mount
articles.summary: Cold weather has begun to set in across Rajasthan at night. On Sunday night, the minimum temperature in Fatehpur and Mount Abu dropped to around 13°C. Except for Jaisalmer, Barmer, Jalore, Jodhpur, Kota and Jaipur, the minimum temperature in most cities fell below 20°C. The Meteorological Department has forecast dry weather and clear skies across the state for three days.

articles.title: Selaulim Reservoir Water Supply Faces New Goa Risk
articles.summary: The change is not only a seasonal variation at a major dam in South Goa. articles.title_hi: सेलौलीम जलाशय जल आपूर्ति को नए गोवा जोखिम का सामना करना पड़ रहा है
articles.summary_hi: यह बदलाव केवल दक्षिण गोवा के एक प्रमुख बांध में मौसमी बदलाव नहीं है। इसने पहले ही बदल दिया है कि वर्ना और मोरमुगाओ तालुकाओं को पानी की आपूर्ति कैसे की जाती है, जहां जल संसाधन विभाग क्यूपेम में कुशावती नदी से पानी उठाकर 25 से 30 मिलियन लीटर की दैनिक आवश्यकता को पूरा कर रहा है।
articles.title_hinglish: selaulima jalashaya jala aapurti ko nae gova jokhima ka samana karana pada raha hai
articles.summary_hinglish: yaha badalava kevala dakshina gova ke eka pramukha bandha men mausami badalava nahin hai। isane pahale hi badala diya hai ki varna aura moramugao talukaon ko pani ki aapurti kaise ki jati hai, jahan jala sansadhana vibhaga kyupema men kushavati nadi se pani uthakara 25 se 30 miliyana litara ki dainika aavashyakata ko pura kara raha hai।

articles.title: LG declares Ladakh India’s first 100 pc Organic Union Territory

articles.title: Bengaluru blast plot was aimed at cousin over land dispute, 3 Assam men arrested
articles.summary: According to police, the prime accused allegedly plotted to murder his cousin over a land dispute, financial issues and a disagreement related to the cancellation of his sister's marriage. articles.title: Goa aims to build innovation-driven AI ecosystem, announces return of tech conclave next

articles.title: AI Stocks Have Lost Over $1 Trillion.The AI Bubble Warning Bell Is Ringing Louder
articles.summary: More than $1 trillion in market capitalisation was wiped from 20 of the world’s most valuable AI and semiconductor stocks during the week ending October 15, 2026, as investors reassessed the cost of financing the technology boom. Nvidia, AMD, Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, SoftBank and several European chipmakers came under pressure.

articles.title: Youuber Dhruv Rathee Detained During Bengaluru Protest Over Election Rolls
articles.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police in Gurugram on October 10 after joining a Cockroach Janta Party protest in Bengaluru. The demonstration demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral-roll irregularities. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi supported the movement, highlighting how digital creators and established political parties are shaping modern Indian political activism.

articles.title: PM Modi to visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on October 25
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on Sunday (October 25), where he will inaugurate a garment manufacturing facility in Varanasi, witness the Indian Air Force's aerial display at Namo Ghat and inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, according to a press release.

articles.title: Death of Indian Tech Journalism: How the ₹3 Lakh iPhone Duo Exposed Influencer Access
articles.summary: Mainstream Indian tech channels responded with unboxing theatricals, “camera mast hai” monologues, and lifestyle flexes. Trapped between leaked ₹26 Lakh PR agency payouts and fear of brand blacklisting, Indian tech YouTube has abandoned technical engineering journalism. The gap between global tech journalism and Indian tech content creation has reached an unsustainable breaking point.

articles.title: Ind AS 118: India Inc gears up for big changes to financial reporting
articles.summary: Indias largest companies are preparing for the implementation of Ind AS 118, which may impact financial reporting. Changes include new classifications for income and expenses, and new operating profit reporting methods. Companies face challenges due to complex requirements and the need for system adjustments. Audit committees are discussing transition plans while awaiting final rules and guidance from regulatory bodies.

articles.title: Indian victim compensation scheme faces severe delays and payout gaps
articles.summary: A new study reveals that India's victim compensation scheme is struggling with rising backlogs and procedural delays, leaving pending cases at 33,257 during the 2023 to 2024 period. The research highlights significant state-wise payout gaps across the country. These administrative bottlenecks hinder justice for victims, prompting concerns about the efficiency of the current support framework moving forward.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय पीड़ित मुआवजा योजना को गंभीर देरी और भुगतान अंतराल का सामना करना पड़ता है

articles.title: India Expands Infrastructure Spending And Boosts Manufacturing Across Multiple Sectors

articles.title: 95 drug samples manufactured in HP fail quality tests
articles.summary: Across the country, 331 drug samples were found to be substandard, with Uttarakhand reporting 69 failures, followed by Maharashtra with 23, Madhya Pradesh with 22 and Haryana with 21. Rajasthan reported 17 failures, while Gujarat and Tamil Nadu reported 15 each and Punjab 13. The findings have brought the quality of medicines manufactured in Himachal Pradesh under scrutiny.
articles.title_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश में निर्मित 95 दवाओं के नमूने गुणवत्ता परीक्षण में विफल रहे
articles.summary_hi: देश भर में, 331 दवाओं के नमूने घटिया पाए गए, जिनमें से उत्तराखंड में 69 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं, इसके बाद महाराष्ट्र में 23, मध्य प्रदेश में 22 और हरियाणा में 21 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं। राजस्थान में 17 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं, जबकि गुजरात और तमिलनाडु में 15-15 और पंजाब में 13 विफलताएं दर्ज की गईं। निष्कर्षों ने हिमाचल प्रदेश में निर्मित दवाओं की गुणवत्ता को जांच के दायरे में ला दिया है।
articles.title_hinglish: himachala pradesha men nirmita 95 davaon ke namune gunavatta parikshana men viphala rahe
articles.summary_hinglish: desha bhara men, 331 davaon ke namune ghatiya pae gae, jinamen se uttarakhanda men 69 viphalataen darja ki gaeen, isake bada maharashtra men 23, madhya pradesha men 22 aura hariyana men 21 viphalataen darja ki gaeen। rajasthana men 17 viphalataen darja ki gaeen, jabaki gujarata aura tamilanadu men 15-15 aura panjaba men 13 viphalataen darja ki gaeen। nishkarshon ne himachala pradesha men nirmita davaon ki gunavatta ko jancha ke dayare men la diya hai।

articles.title: Karnataka's DK Shivakumar warns IT firms of action over alleged bias against Kannadigas

articles.title: IndiGo, Air India Express to shift Mumbai flights to Navi Mumbai airport
articles.summary: India’s two biggest airline groups are preparing to move more flights to Navi Mumbai International Airport, a shift that will free up capacity at Mumbai’s existing airport as it prepares for a major terminal redevelopment. IndiGo will begin international operations from Navi Mumbai in February 2027, transferring 12 daily departures from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Adani Airports said Sunday.

articles.title: Eminent Indian Painter and Former Parliamentarian Jogen Chowdhury Dies at 87
articles.summary: Eminent Indian painter and former Member of Parliament Jogen Chowdhury passed away on Sunday at the age of 87 following a battle with rare blood cancer. Known as the master of the unbroken line, his distinctive artworks blended traditional and modern styles. He also served as a professor at Visva Bharati University and shaped contemporary art.

articles.title: B.tech graduate from Jamtara among 2 men arrested over credit card KYC scam
articles.summary: Delhi Police has arrested two men from Jharkhand for their alleged involvement in a cyber-fraud racket that cheated more than 50 people by posing as bank officials and misusing their credit card details, news agency PTI reported. The accused allegedly targeted people aged over 50 on the pretext of updating their credit card Know Your Customer (KYC) details.

articles.title_hinglish: kredita karda kevaeesi ghotale men giraphtara do logon men jamatadaा se biteka snataka bhi shamila hai
articles.summary_hinglish: samachara ejensi pitiaaee ki riporta ke anusar, dilli pulisa ne saibara-dhokhadhadaी raiketa men kathita sanliptata ke lie jharakhanda se do logon ko giraphtara kiya hai, jinhonne khuda ko bainka adhikari batakara aura unake kredita karda vivarana ka durupayoga karake 50 se adhika logon ko dhokha diya tha। aaropiyon ne kathita taura para apane kredita karda no yora kastamara (kevaeesi) vivarana ko apadeta karane ke bahane 50 varsha se adhika umra ke logon ko nishana banaya।

articles.title: Why peaceful protests remain the most effective tool for change in India
articles.summary: Recent comments by public figures calling for institutional anarchy and military intervention have sparked debate over dissent in India. Historical data shows nonviolent campaigns succeed twice as often as violent ones. Experts emphasize that maintaining institutional stability and peaceful demonstrations is vital for accountability, protecting citizens, and ensuring democratic survival.

articles.title: Market recap: Eight of top 10 firms lose Rs 1.55 lakh crore; HDFC Bank
articles.summary: The combined market valuation of eight of India’s top 10 most valuable companies declined by Rs 1. 55 lakh crore last week, with HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance emerging as the biggest losers. Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and Larsen & Toubro (L&T) were the only two firms in the top 10 to record gains in their market capitalisation.

articles.title: Oath-Taking Ceremony of New Jammu Kashmir Ministers Likely on Tuesday

articles.title: Bangladesh Government Ensures Safe Hindu Festival Amid Tight Security
articles.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman deployed thousands of security personnel across Bangladesh to safeguard the annual Hindu festival of Durga Puja. Authorities extended official holidays and increased financial assistance to committees, ensuring celebrations remained peaceful. This heavy deployment aimed to protect the minority community following years of anxiety and past violence, though community leaders continue demanding long-term justice.

articles.title: Congress Accuses Government Of Interfering In Judiciary Following Retired Judge Memoir
